ui.m_energia_d: Today's star is carbohydrates (filled pasta, pizza, gnocchi or potatoes): lots of energy to play all afternoon.

Short pasta with a simple tomato sauce, slowly cooked with a drizzle of oil. A great classic almost everyone loves.

Pasta with a green pesto with a mild flavour, made for little palates.
